title: Two Coast Guard men shot dead as gunmen fire on PCG vehicle in Cotabato City
summary: Seaman Second Class Reniel Agpalo and Apprentice Seaman Louther John Vitor of the Philippine Coast Guard's Cotabato City Station were shot dead when two masked gunmen on a motorcycle fired into both sides of the vehicle carrying them and their station chief, Lt. Commander John Paul Cabarrubias, along Roman Vilo Street, Poblacion 6, Cotabato City, at noon on Thursday, 22 October 2026. Both were hit in the head and declared dead on arrival at hospital; the station chief was unhurt. Police recovered seven spent shells believed to be from a 9mm pistol; investigators were looking at a work-related motive or a personal dispute.

sources.title: 2 PCG men shot dead in Cotabato City; station chief unharmed

title: Teduray leader and village councilor shot dead on the highway in Datu Unsay
summary: Joel Magtud, a Teduray leader and councilor of Barangay Macalag Mahantao, Datu Hoffer, was shot dead by two men on a motorcycle who followed him and opened fire as he rode along the national highway in Datu Unsay, Maguindanao del Sur, on the evening of Saturday, 17 October 2026. He was declared dead on arrival at the Bangsamoro Regional Medical Center. Police named a person of interest and formed a special investigation task group.

sources.title: Non-Moro IPs raise safety concerns after Maguindanao killings
